scope: PostgreSQL custom enum metadata and schema-aware consumers with Unicode identifiers
contract: Unicode schema and enum type names are preserved by fetch_columns metadata discovery.
Schema-aware keyed update, draft insert, and structured equality filter retain the native enum type.
An invalid label returns PostgreSQL SQLSTATE 22P02 without changing a sibling or SQL NULL row.
Native catalog schema/type names and stored enum values match the expected Unicode identifiers and labels.

quoted_enum_identifier_tests.command: rtk cargo test --offline --locked -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration enum_identifiers_ -- --ignored --test-threads=1

remaining: Other PostgreSQL identifier forms, transaction/search_path permutations, wider enum configurations, and the B3 engine/type/consumer matrix remain open.
This focused case does not qualify B3 or the 0.2.0 release.
